patternName: UTC Database to Local Time Horizon Conversion
description: Converts UTC database strings explicitly into the local Hermosillo, Sonora (UTC-7) presentation target before rendering timestamps to lists or thermal printing templates.
implementationExample: const utcDate = new Date(item.paymentDate + (item.paymentDate.includes('Z') ? '' : 'Z')); const hermosilloDate = new Date(utcDate.getTime() - (7 * 60 * 60 * 1000));

patternName: Network Resilience & Local Paths Recovery Pattern
description: Protects asset rendering pipeline by intercepting structural data failures and transparently routing execution toward predictable internal paths.
implementationExample: catch (error) { console.warn('Error saving image, using local path'); return `/public/assets/${filename}`; }

patternName: Virtual Buffer Infinite Scroll Data Loading
description: Protects mobile DOM memory capacity metrics during massive list evaluations by splitting state objects into dynamic window arrays.
Guarantees layout normalization parameters on regional printing processes by locking local variables to zero regardless of server response state variations.

patternName: Non-Blocking Toast Instead of Blocking Confirm Alert
description: Staff-facing wizard flows use a single dynamically-colored IonToast (success/warning/danger by message prefix) instead of an IonAlert confirm dialog. Avoids gating a workflow on a modal decision when the real follow-up (e.g. an incomplete step) can instead be handled asynchronously via a push-notification reminder rather than blocking the current screen.

A horizontally-scrollable multi-step wizard indicator (7+ steps) never auto-scrolled on its own, so the active step could sit off-screen with no visual indication of progress. Fix: hold a ref on the active step's element and call scrollIntoView on every step change.
implementationExample: const activeStepRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null); useEffect(() => { activeStepRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' }); }, [wizardStep]);

patternName: Embedded Stripe Components Instead of Hosted-URL Redirect
description: Stripe Connect onboarding (and card SetupIntent collection) render in-app via @stripe/connect-js / @stripe/react-stripe-js Elements rather than window.open()-ing Stripe's hosted AccountLink URL. Keeps the client inside the native wizard flow end-to-end; required once the account moved from sandbox to Stripe live mode.
